title: Flutter Developer
description:
**Job Title - Flutter Developer**

**Reporting to - Team Leader**

**Roles and responsibilities-**

● Develop and implement user interfaces for mobile applications, ensuring a seamless and engaging user experience.​

● Connect front-end applications with back-end services, ensuring efficient data flow and functionality.​

● Analyze user requirements and design scalable, maintainable application architectures.​

● Write clean, efficient code and troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications.​

● Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and performance across various devices.​

● Ensure application security by implementing appropriate authentication and data protection protocols.

**Experience- 2 to 5 years**

**Skills required-**

● Bachelor’s degree in computer science or software engineering.

● Solid understanding of the Dart programming language and the Flutter framework for building cross-platform applications.​

● Knowledge of design principles and experience in creating responsive and user-friendly interfaces.​

● Familiarity with mobile application architectures such as MVP, MVVM, or MVC.

● Experience in integrating APIs and working with backend services to connect applications with databases and other services.​

● Proficiency in using version control tools like Git for collaborative development.​

● Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities to identify and resolve application issues.​

● Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Android Application Developer
description:
**Android App Developer**

* Design, develop, and maintain Android applications.
* Write clean, efficient, and scalable code using Kotlin or Java.
* Integrate APIs, databases, and third-party services.
* Test and debug applications to ensure smooth performance.
* Collaborate with the design and development team to improve app functionality and user experience.
* Maintain and update existing applications as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Android Development (Java/Kotlin)
* React Native or Flutter
* Firebase & API Integration
* Database Handling
* Real-Time Dashboard Development
* Graphs, Reports & Analytics
* Google Maps Integration
* AWS / Cloud Services

**Preferred:**

* IoT & ESP32 Device Integration
* MQTT Protocol
* Play Store Deployment Experience

**What You'll Work On:**

* Air Quality Monitoring Apps
* Industrial IoT Dashboards
* Device Monitoring & Control Applications
* Real-Time Data Visualization Systems

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Application development: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person
